title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Microsoft Azure
providers.scope_notes: Covers Microsoft Azure (Azure Storage, Azure Resource Manager, Microsoft Entra Workload ID, Azure DevOps Services). Azure Storage and ARM controls are per subscription/account; Conditional Access for workload identities needs Workload Identities Premium; Azure DevOps PAT policies need an Entra-backed organization. Entra delegated/app-only OAuth for Graph and managed identities are covered by the separate microsoft platform.

controls.name: Allow storage account key access (AllowSharedKeyAccess = false)
controls.what: Rejects all requests authorized with account keys, including account and service SAS; user delegation SAS still works.
controls.setting: Storage account > Configuration > Allow storage account key access; ARM property allowSharedKeyAccess

controls.name: Azure Policy: Storage accounts should prevent shared key access
controls.what: Audits or prevents storage accounts that permit Shared Key authorization.

controls.name: Regenerate key (RegenerateKey)
controls.what: Replaces an account key and revokes SAS signed with that key.
controls.setting: Storage account > Access keys > Rotate key; POST .../regenerateKey

controls.name: Storage firewall network rules
controls.what: Limits which IPs, VNets and resource instances can reach the account endpoint.

controls.name: SAS expiration policy (Log / Block)
controls.what: Sets a recommended max SAS interval for service and account SAS; Block denies out-of-policy SAS, default Log allows them.

controls.name: Stored access policy
controls.what: Service SAS bound to a stored access policy can be revoked by changing or deleting the policy.

controls.name: Revoke user delegation keys
controls.what: Revokes all user delegation keys for the account, invalidating every user delegation SAS.

no_control.what: Azure does not track issued SAS tokens, so there is no inventory or per-token revoke for account SAS.

controls_unknown: Whether Azure Activity Log records the service principal identity for ARM read calls made with azure-3/azure-4 tokens (Activity log typically skips reads).
Exact Entra audit activity name for adding/removing a federated identity credential.
Default of the Azure DevOps "IP Conditional Access policy validation on non-interactive flows" policy.

Token format or prefix for storage keys, SAS, client secrets or Azure DevOps PATs.

auth_paths.name: Shared access signatures (SAS): account SAS, service SAS, user delegation SAS

authentication.summary: Signed URL token. Account and service SAS are signed with an account key; user delegation SAS is signed with a user delegation key obtained with Entra credentials (Blob only). Anyone holding the SAS can use it.

federation.details: Account/service SAS rely on Shared Key and bypass Entra; user delegation SAS is authorized with Entra credentials and still works when Shared Key is disabled.

ip_restriction.boundary: Optional signed IP (sip) in the SAS plus the storage firewall; the SAS IP cannot grant access beyond firewall rules.

lifetime.summary: Expiry set by creator; user delegation key max 7 days; SAS expiration policy can Log or Block over-long SAS

administration.summary: SAS tokens are not tracked by Azure. Controls: disallow Shared Key (blocks account/service SAS), SAS expiration policy, stored access policies (service SAS only), revoke user delegation keys, regenerate account keys.
administration.conditions: Stored access policies not supported for account or user delegation SAS.

sso.details: A user delegation SAS is secured with Entra credentials; account and service SAS are signed with Shared Key, which Conditional Access does not cover unless Shared Key is disallowed.

inventory.details: SAS tokens are generated client-side and Azure Storage does not track them.

sso.ui: Storage account > Settings > Configuration > Allow storage account key access = Disabled (leaves only Entra-backed user delegation SAS)

usage.ui: Log Analytics (after diagnostic setting): StorageBlobLogs | where AuthenticationType == "SAS"; AuthenticationHash identifies the SAS

reads.ui: Log Analytics: StorageBlobLogs | where AuthenticationType == "SAS" and OperationName == "GetBlob"

kill.ui: Account/service SAS: Storage account > Security + networking > Access keys > Regenerate the signing key, or change/delete the stored access policy. User delegation SAS: revoke delegation keys

token_format.notes: SAS is a query-string token appended to the resource URL.

log_sources.name: Azure Storage resource logs (StorageBlobLogs)
log_sources.notes: Data-plane requests incl. AuthenticationType and AuthenticationHash; not collected until a diagnostic setting routes them.

containment.steps: Account/service SAS: regenerate signing key or change stored access policy. User delegation SAS: revoke-delegation-keys. Or disallow Shared Key.
containment.notes: User delegation revocation may be delayed by caching.

unknown: Creation of a SAS is client-side and not logged.

calls.log_notes: StorageBlobLogs only if diagnostic setting configured.

unknown: No whoami call for Shared Key or SAS.

detections.title: Azure Storage SAS Token Access from External IP
detections.detects: Successful storage requests signed with a SAS token (sig= in the URI) from a public IP.

detections.title: Azure VM Disk SAS URI Generated
detections.detects: A SAS URI was generated for a managed disk (download access to disk contents).
